OVERVIEW: /usr/bin/llvm-debuginfod

USAGE: llvm-debuginfod [options] <Directories to scan>

OPTIONS:
  -c <ulong>  Maximum number of files to scan concurrently. If 0, use the hardware concurrency.
  --help      Display available options
  -h          Alias for --help
  -i <string> Host interface to bind to.
  -m <number> Minimum number of seconds to wait before an on-demand update can betriggered by a request for a buildid which is not in the collection.
  -p <uint>   Port to listen on. Set to 0 to bind to any available port.
  -t <int>    Number of seconds to wait between subsequent automated scans of the filesystem.
  -v          Enable verbose logging.
